name: Group Exchange Rate
description: The group's governed exchange rates (konsol#103): one Closing and one Average rate per fiscal period, from each currency into a group reporting currency. Group finance enters or pre-fills them from the ERP; submitting is the approval. Translation reads only these.

fields.label: Group Reporting Currency
fields.description: The currency a consolidation group presents in (its node's Reporting Currency). Only rates into a group reporting currency are entered; cross rates are derived.

fields.label: Rate Type
fields.description: Closing translates the balance sheet; Average translates the P&L. Historical equity rates stay in Historical Equity Rate.

fields.label: Fiscal Period
fields.description: The period number, as on Period Status (1-12; 0 = OPN, 13 = CLS).

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: The quote. Normally units of the group reporting currency per 1 unit of the from-currency; with Inverse Quote ticked, units of the from-currency per 1 unit of the group currency. A true rate: no multiplier (#138). A quote below 0.1 is entered the other way round, so it keeps its digits.

fields.label: Inverse Quote
fields.description: Ticked: Rate is units of the from-currency per 1 unit of the group currency (1350 KRW per USD), for a currency whose rate into the group currency is far below 1. MariaDB keeps 9 decimal places, which would leave KRW to USD 0.00074 with 5 significant digits; the warehouse inverts it at full precision.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Manual: entered by a person. ERP pre-fill: proposed from the ERP feed and accepted by a person; editing the rate makes it Manual. Adoption: taken over from the ERP feed by the one-time upgrade (konsol#103), authored by the system and not reviewed by a person.

fields.label: ERP Quote
fields.description: What the ERP feed quoted when this rate was proposed, in the same direction as Rate. Reference only: translation never reads the ERP feed. Recorded by Pre-fill from ERP only.

fields.label: Reason for Change
fields.description: Required when this rate amends a cancelled one, and when it moves more than 50% from the previous approved rate for its key or from the ERP quote. A rate in a closed period changes only after the period is reopened; the reopen, the cancelled rate and this reason are the audit trail.
